rooms.label: r_shop_surf
rooms.name: Ocean Blvd Surf
rooms.why: surf shop and ding repair at 11th and J Ave, one block from Ocean Blvd and the beach: boards walk down to the water from here

rooms.label: r_shop_cafe
rooms.name: Ridge Coffee
rooms.why: the regulars' cafe at 9th and G Ave, at the top of Country Club Ridge: dog walkers and the morning commute down the hill stop here

rooms.label: r_shop_books
rooms.name: Hillside Books
rooms.why: a used bookshop on the corner of 10th and E Ave: the walk from the houses up the hill passes it, and it has been there longer than most of the owners
